verdict.rationale: Mangopay is a payments and wallet API platform, not an agent or AI assistant, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The documented MCP server (mangopay-probe-3) is server-side: it exposes Mangopay to other agents and does not show that Mangopay consumes MCP tools, so it is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
